questions.question: As a Senior Engineer on the Modem Protocol team (LTE/NR RRC), what are you working towards right now?
questions.answer: I'm a senior engineer on the Modem Protocol team, LTE/NR RRC, in Bangalore. Right now I'm getting the RRC re-establishment fix into the November release and leading our 3GPP RAN2 contributions.

questions.question: Who matters most in your work, and what kinds of mail from them should we treat as especially important?
questions.answer: Meera Iyer is my manager. Karthik Nair leads PLM releases for our team. Wei Zhang is our counterpart in the Seoul HQ modem group. Rahul Sharma, Divya Menon and Sanjay Rao are on my team. Anything from Meera, release blockers, customer escalations, 3GPP contribution deadlines, and anything HR or IT says I personally must do by a date.

questions.question: What mail would you consider low priority or never want to be bothered by?
questions.answer: Anything from Meera, release blockers, customer escalations, 3GPP contribution deadlines, and anything HR or IT says I personally must do by a date. Celebrations, cafeteria and transport notices, town hall recaps, newsletters and vendor marketing. I'm not a people manager, so manager-only actions don't apply to me.

questions.question: How would you like important mail surfaced to you?
questions.answer: Anything from Meera, release blockers, customer escalations, 3GPP contribution deadlines, and anything HR or IT says I personally must do by a date. Only notify me for things due today or by tomorrow morning. Everything else can wait for my Today page.
